questions.explanation: We use 'will' for predictions about the future.
questions.explanationAr: نستخدم 'will' للتنبؤات حول المستقبل.

questions.explanation: We use 'will' for promises.
questions.explanationAr: نستخدم 'will' للوعود.

questions.explanation: We use the base form (V1) of the verb after 'will' or 'll'.
questions.explanationAr: نستخدم الصيغة الأساسية للفعل (V1) بعد 'will' أو 'll'.

questions.text: I'm thirsty. I _____ buy some water.
questions.explanation: For spontaneous decisions made at the moment of speaking, we use 'will'.
questions.explanationAr: للقرارات العفوية المتخذة في لحظة التحدث، نستخدم 'will'.

questions.text: I have a test tomorrow. I _____ study.
questions.explanation: For plans or intentions made beforehand, we use 'going to'.
questions.explanationAr: للخطط أو النوايا المتخذة مسبقًا، نستخدم 'going to'.

questions.explanation: The negative form of the Future Simple is 'will not' (won't).
questions.explanationAr: صيغة النفي للمستقبل البسيط هي 'will not' (won't).

questions.explanation: The negative contraction for 'will not' is 'won't'.
questions.explanationAr: الاختصار السلبي لـ 'will not' هو 'won't'.

questions.explanation: Questions in the Future Simple start with 'Will'.
questions.explanationAr: الأسئلة في المستقبل البسيط تبدأ بـ 'Will'.

questions.explanation: Questions in the Future Simple start with 'Will'.
questions.explanationAr: الأسئلة في المستقبل البسيط تبدأ بـ 'Will'.

questions.text: Will you help me? Yes, I _____.
questions.explanation: The short affirmative answer is 'Yes, I will'.
questions.explanationAr: الإجابة القصيرة بالإيجاب هي 'Yes, I will'.

questions.explanation: The short negative answer is 'No, he won't'.
questions.explanationAr: الإجابة القصيرة بالنفي هي 'No, he won't'.

questions.text: Which of these is a signal word for the Future Simple?
questions.explanation: 'tomorrow' is a signal word for the future.
questions.explanationAr: 'tomorrow' هي كلمة دلالية للمستقبل.

questions.explanation: 'soon' is a signal word for the Future Simple.
questions.explanationAr: 'soon' هي كلمة دلالية للمستقبل البسيط.

questions.text: We will travel to London _____ week.
questions.explanation: 'next week' indicates a future action.
questions.explanationAr: 'next week' تشير إلى إجراء مستقبلي.

questions.explanation: 'tomorrow' is a common signal word for the Future Simple.
questions.explanationAr: 'tomorrow' هي كلمة دلالية شائعة للمستقبل البسيط.

questions.explanation: Questions about the future start with 'Will'.
questions.explanationAr: الأسئلة حول المستقبل تبدأ بـ 'Will'.

questions.explanation: The base form of the verb 'to be' is 'be'. We say 'will be'.
questions.explanationAr: الصيغة الأساسية للفعل 'to be' هي 'be'. نقول 'will be'.

questions.explanation: After 'won't' (will not), we use the base form of the verb without 'to'.
questions.explanationAr: بعد 'won't' (will not)، نستخدم الصيغة الأساسية للفعل بدون 'to'.

questions.explanation: Use 'Will' for future questions.
questions.explanationAr: استخدم 'Will' لأسئلة المستقبل.

questions.explanation: Use the base verb 'go' after 'won't'.
questions.explanationAr: استخدم الفعل الأساسي 'go' بعد 'won't'.

questions.text: 'I will going to the mall.' is a correct sentence.
questions.explanation: It is incorrect. You must use the base form after 'will': 'I will go to the mall.'
questions.explanationAr: إنه غير صحيح. يجب استخدام الصيغة الأساسية بعد 'will': 'I will go to the mall.'

questions.text: 'Will he comes tomorrow?' is a correct question.
questions.explanation: It is incorrect. We do not add 's' to the verb after 'will'. It should be 'Will he come tomorrow?'
questions.explanationAr: إنه غير صحيح. لا نضيف 's' للفعل بعد 'will'. يجب أن يكون 'Will he come tomorrow?'

questions.text: 'They won't to travel.' is a correct sentence.
questions.explanation: It is incorrect. Do not use 'to' after 'won't'. It should be 'They won't travel.'
questions.explanationAr: إنه غير صحيح. لا تستخدم 'to' بعد 'won't'. يجب أن يكون 'They won't travel.'

questions.text: 'I will visit my aunt tomorrow.' is a correct sentence.
questions.explanation: It is correct. It uses 'will' + base form for a future action.
questions.explanationAr: إنه صحيح. يستخدم 'will' + الصيغة الأساسية لإجراء مستقبلي.

questions.text: 'I will help you.' is an example of a promise.
questions.explanation: It is true. 'will' is often used for promises.
questions.explanationAr: إنه صحيح. 'will' غالباً ما تستخدم للوعود.
